newsitem.title: USA: White House declines comment before FOMC meeting.
newsitem.headline: White House declines comment before FOMC meeting.

text.p: White House spokesman Mike McCurry on Monday declined all comment ahead of the Federal Reserve Board's policy-making meeting on Tuesday.
"We have the habitual desire not to say anything about actions of the independent Fed," McCurry told reporters when asked about the meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee.

Asked if President Bill Clinton had met Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan since their last publicly disclosed meeting on January 8, McCurry replied: "I am not aware of any besides the most recent one I told you about."
